sections.content:
For other uses, see Loch (disambiguation).
Loch is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. He is one of the Four Heroes of Palmyna who fought alongside Edea, Dean and Lorand in order to free Palmyna from the tyranny of Cardes, one of the Four Fallen Gods.

sections.content: As an NPC character, Loch's first appearance is in Grand Quest - Four Heroes of Palmyna.

sections.title: Background
sections.content: Lacking the ability of being able to use a sword, he excels much further in the art of archery. His signature weapon, Eshuon is empowered with Thunder, allowing him to inflict catastrophic damage to its targets. }}'''Loch''' is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. He is one of the Four Heroes of Palmyna who fought alongside Edea, Dean and Lorand in order to free Palmyna from the tyranny of {{c|Cardes}}, one of the Four Fallen Gods.

==In-Game Appearance==
As an NPC character, Loch's first appearance is in [[GQ:Palmyna|Grand Quest - Four Heroes of Palmyna]].

==Background==
Lacking the ability of being able to use a sword, he excels much further in the art of archery. His signature weapon, [[Eshuon]] is empowered with Thunder, allowing him to inflict catastrophic damage to its targets. He also demonstrates its power in order to land the final blow to Cardes, however, the blow was so strong, causing him to accidentally open the Spirit World.
